source: Fictional B2B software support policy. No customer records.
purpose: Exercise declared routing decisions, including policy boundaries; not estimate production prevalence.
split_semantics: Visible family-separated partitions. All variants and inherited members of a family stay together. Neither partition is an unseen holdout.
invariants: The same unresolved request escalates at two or more prior contacts, regardless of priority.
Customer tier alone changes none of the three answers.
Quoted instructions do not override policy or structured contact counts.
Resolved, hypothetical and negated incidents do not inherit the severity of an active incident.
Missing information does not supply an unstated security incident or outage.

review.required: Review every new family and its transformation assumptions, every high-consequence case and every dispute. Review all labels before claiming the full set is reviewed.
review.independence: The same author prepared scenarios, labels and deterministic transformations. Automated agreement is not independent adjudication.
